question: ___________ is celebrated as the New Year of Kerala.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vishu.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Vishu:-**

 
 
• It is celebrated as the New Year of Kerala.
 
• Vishu is a Hindu festival celebrated in the Indian state of Kerala and marks the beginning of the Malayalam calendar year.
